title: Public Website Claude Design Integration & QA v0.1
objective: Rebuild the public website against RepoAssure Design System v2 and restructure its information architecture around the four questions recorded in ADR-0013, separating delivery sequence from delivery roles. Re-baseline the website guardrail suite so it asserts rendered structure and preserved guarantees rather than superseded source text.
acceptance: The website states the ADR-0013 four-question positioning: ready to ship, evidence, blockers, and what to fix first.
Delivery sequence content and delivery role content occupy separate sections.
Light is the default theme. Dark is opt-in. Evidence blocks use the console surface.
Brand assets, theme-color, and the web manifest are consistent with the adopted theme.
Trust boundary claims are independently auditable and match implementation.
All user-visible copy remains in apps/website/src/i18n.ts so the forbidden-claim guard keeps covering it.
English and Simplified Chinese parity is preserved. No locale is added.
Guardrail tests preserve claim, bilingual, focus-visible, and mobile overflow guarantees.
Guardrail assertions that pinned superseded class names, token values, and file layout are rewritten against rendered structure.
Website build, typecheck, unit tests, lint, and browser verification pass or record explicit environmental blockers.
docs/design/design-system-v0.1.md and docs/design/website-uiux-roadmap-v0.2.md are reissued against the adopted design system.
